title: Don't scroll! Learn how to give CPR and use an AED
description:
Every second counts when someone goes into Sudden Cardiac Arrest. 💓 

Project Heart Beat is our nationally and internationally recognized program teaching San Diegans how to save lives through early defibrillation. Since the program began 24 years ago, we've educated hundreds of people on the use of AEDs and placed more than 11,000 throughout our communities.

For more CPR/AED training information, visit sandiego.gov/sdprojectheartbeat.
